s2.ptxt: Fix the rear differential carrier assembly to the overhaul attachment.
Remove the 4 stud bolts from the transmission coupling assembly.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10mm, remove the rear differential drain plug and gasket.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 10mm, remove the rear differential filler plug and gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Differential Carrier Cover Plug

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 8mm, remove the rear differential carrier cover plug.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Differential Carrier Cover Breather Plug

s2.ptxt: Using a chisel and hammer, raise the rear differential carrier cover breather plug slightly.
Lightly pry with a screwdriver to remove the rear differential carrier cover breather plug.
Install a dial indicator and lever type stylus at a right angle to the inside surface of the transmission coupling assembly.
Using SST, turn the transmission coupling assembly forward and in reverse to measure its vertical runout.
Install a dial indicator at a right angle to the transmission coupling assembly at the position shown in the illustration.
Using SST, turn the transmission coupling assembly forward and in reverse to measure its lateral runout.
Remove the 4 bolts, and using a plastic hammer, lightly tap the rear differential carrier cover to remove it from the rear differential carrier assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Apply the brass bar to the rib of the rear differential carrier cover.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the snap ring.
Remove the solenoid from the yoke.
Remove the O-ring from the solenoid.
Using a socket hexagon wrench 5mm, remove the 3 bolts and remove the yoke from the differential carrier assembly.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Transmission Coupling Conical Spring Washer

s2.ptxt: Remove the transmission coupling conical spring washer from the rear differential carrier assembly.
Remove the transmission coupling shim from the rear differential carrier assembly.
Insert a dial indicator through the rear differential carrier cover plug hole, and place it at a right angle to the tip of the ring gear tooth surface.
Using SST, hold the drive pinion.
Using SST, turn the rear differential case forward and in reverse to check the backlash.

atten3.ptxt: Measure at 3 or more locations around the ring gear circumference.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a torque wrench, measure the preload (starting torque) within the backlash range between the differential drive pinion and differential ring gear.
Using SST and a torque wrench, check the preload (starting torque) with the differential drive pinion and differential ring gear tooth surfaces in contact.

specitem.ptxt: Total preload = drive pinion preload + 0.99 to 1.63N*m{10 to 17kgf*cm}

atten3.ptxt: To seat the case bearings, turn forward and in reverse several times before measuring.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Differential Side Gear Shaft Oil Seal

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the 2 rear differential side gear shaft oil seals from the rear differential carrier assembly.
Using SST, remove the diaphragm oil seal from the rear differential carrier assembly.
Using SST and a hammer, unstake the rear drive pinion nut.

item.ptxt: Use the SST with the tapered surface toward the shaft.
Do not grind the tip of the SST with a grinder or equivalent.
Completely unstake the rear drive pinion nut.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, hold the differential drive pinion and remove the rear drive pinion nut from the differential drive pinion.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Pinion Tapered Roller Bearing Front

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing front (inner race) from the rear differential carrier assembly.
Remove the 8 bolts.
Using a brass bar and hammer, lightly tap the differential side bearing retainer to remove it.

atten3.ptxt: Apply the brass bar to the rib of the differential side bearing retainer.

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear differential case from the rear differential carrier.
Remove the differential drive pinion from the rear differential carrier.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Differential Drive Pinion Bearing Spacer

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear differential drive pinion bearing spacer from the differential drive pinion.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Pinion Tapered Roller Bearing Rear

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing rear (inner race) from the differential drive pinion.

atten3.ptxt: If the rear differential drive pinion or differential ring gear is damaged, replace them with a rear differential final gear kit.

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear differential drive pinion washer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Pinion Tapered Roller Bearing Front

s2.ptxt: Hook the claws of the SST onto the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing front (outer race) through the cutouts in the differential carrier assembly.
Using SST, remove the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing front (outer race) from the rear differential carrier.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Drive Pinion Tapered Roller Bearing Rear

s2.ptxt: Using a brass bar and hammer, remove the rear drive pinion tapered roller bearing rear (outer race) while tapping it lightly and evenly.

atten3.ptxt: Apply the brass bar to the cutouts.

s2.ptxt: Using SST and a press, remove the rear differential case bearing RH (outer race) and rear differential side gear shaft plate washer from the rear differential carrier.
Using SST and a press, remove the rear differential case bearing LH (outer race) and rear differential side gear shaft plate washer from the differential side bearing retainer.
Using SST, remove the rear differential case bearing RH (inner race) from the rear differential case.

atten3.ptxt: Apply grease or oil to the threads and tip of the SST center bolt 09953-04020 before use.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the rear differential case bearing LH (inner race) from the rear differential case.

atten3.ptxt: Apply grease or oil to the threads and tip of the SST center bolt 09953-04020 before use.

atten4.ptxt: If part of the race remains on the rear differential case, remove the race again using the same procedure.

s2.ptxt: Using aluminum plates, secure the rear differential case in a vise.
Put matchmarks on the rear differential case and differential ring gear.
Remove the 10 bolts.
Using a plastic hammer, lightly tap the outer circumference of the differential ring gear to remove it from the rear differential case.

atten4.ptxt: Place a shop rag against the tooth surface side of the ring gear to prevent damage.

atten3.ptxt: If the rear differential drive pinion or differential ring gear is damaged, replace them with a rear differential final gear kit.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Differential Breather Plug Oil Deflector

s2.ptxt: Using a socket hexagon wrench 5, remove the 2 bolts and the rear differential breather plug oil deflector.
Remove the 4 straight pins from the rear differential carrier.
